rows.en:
(Alto's acrobatics in today's EX-Gear class
were so sharp. Seriously amazing.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
Alto, that acrobatic move you pulled in class
today came off really clean.
Heh, I was just in good form today.
Really...
rows.notes: Michel, leading into the next row.

rows.en: You're not half bad, Princess.
rows.notes: Hime = Alto's teasing nickname 'Princess' (glossary alias).

rows.en:
Michael......!
How many times have I told you not to call me
Princess...
rows.notes: Alto uses the full name Mihaeru: 'Michael' per glossary en (Michael Blanc).

rows.en:
Don't get so worked up.
You'll ruin that pretty face of yours.
Knock it off!
Whoops, guess I took the joke a little too far.
What were you even trying to do, Michel?

Well, you see,
he wanted to compliment Alto-senpai, but he
was too embarrassed to just say it straight.
Right, Michel-senpai?
No comment.

(Geez, he's so hard to read.
He should just compliment him straight out...)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
(Hmm,
I forgot until I took my first class of the year,
but it's already a new year: 2059, huh.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
(Last year was so hectic, with me joining S.M.S.
and all, it doesn't even feel like the year
changed.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
(Well, then again, a lot happened,
so I guess it was a pretty full year.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en: (I wonder what kind of year this one'll be.)

(A sudden meeting? That's unusual.
Did something happen?)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
All right, everyone's here.
Let's start the emergency meeting.

We've received a request to perform EX-Gear
acrobatics at a certain singer's
concert.

Whether we accept this request or not
is today's topic.
Let me hear what you all think.
(Hmm... let's see......)

Wait, huh?
Whose concert is it, anyway?

Whoops, I forgot to explain that.
I don't know if you guys have heard of her,
but......
rows.notes: Singer is Sheryl (female, next row).

rows.en: It's a concert by someone called Sheryl Nome.

rows.notes: Pilot Students in chorus.

rows.en:
Word is, people call her the Galactic Fairy
or something.

H-hey,
...S...seriously,
it's Sheryl's concert?
Yeah, seriously.

rows.notes: Michel here; also the player in scd_tst_005.

rows.en: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!!
rows.notes: Pilot Students in chorus.

rows.en:
Heh, you guys reacted even better than I
expected. Couldn't be happier.

I don't think I even need to ask,
but we're doing the show, right?
No proble~~~~~~m!!!!
rows.notes: Pilot Students in chorus.

rows.en:
Geez, you guys are so easy to read.
Makes my job a lot easier.
Hehe, they sure are.
rows.notes: Luca agreeing with Michel.

rows.en:
And what about Alto-kun over there with the
sour face? Not happy about doing the concert?
rows.notes: Michel says Alto-kun (mock-polite).

rows.en: ......Not really.

Getting that mad will ruin your cute little
face, Prin-cess Alto.
rows.notes: Hi-me spelled out with a dot for emphasis; rendered 'Prin-cess'.

rows.en:
Grr!
Mi~cha~el~~!!
rows.notes: Name drawn out syllable by syllable (Mihaeru = Michael).

rows.en: Geez, you two are always fighting.
Will the concert be okay with things like this?

It'll be fine.
If nothing else, everyone's skills are the
real deal.
Guess that's true.

(Sheryl Nome......
I get to meet the Galactic Fairy.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en:
(I should at least get ready to ask for
her autograph...)

(Oh, today's Valentine's Day.
If I don't get chocolate from anybody,
I'll be pretty bummed...)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.en: So this is where you all were, \p-kun.
rows.notes: \p-kun tachi = the player and the others.

rows.en:
What's up, Nanase?
You need something from us?

Since today's Valentine's Day,
I brought chocolate for everyone, but......

It's homemade, so I'm sorry if it's not
to your taste.

Y-you made it yourself, Nanase-san?!
Then it's definitely going to be delicious!
Thank you, Luca-kun.
Nanase-san......

Okay, next I'll give Ranka-san my true-love
cho...!
rows.notes: Honmei choco, cut off mid-word as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
......I mean,
I have to go give her some friend chocolate,
so if you'll excuse me.
rows.notes: Tomo-choco = friend chocolate (for Ranka).

rows.en:
Lucky you, Luca.
Nanase gave you some 'ob-li-ga-tion' chocolate.
rows.notes: Gi-ri choco spelled out for emphasis: obligation chocolate.

rows.en: Haah~ Nanase-san's homemade chocolate......
Good grief......

So, Princess, aren't you gonna give me
any chocolate?
Like hell I would!
Aww~ Alto, you're not giving us any chocolate?

And I thought this year I'd finally get some
from Alto......
You guys......!!
Ahahahahaha!

(Phew, well, I guess I'm lucky I got any
at all?)
